XJQU: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenance to all.
He never think of him who gave him the soul and body and who provides all with sustenance.
SJCK: The noose of death shall not be cut away from their necks; they shall come and go in reincarnation over and over again.
The noose of death shall not be cut from his neck and he shall continue to come and go over and over again.
KUW4: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they are pre-ordained to do.
The blind self-willed man understands nothing and practises what is pre-destined for him.
RHFG: Through perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace, and the Naam comes to abide in the mind.
Through the perfect good fortune, True Guru, the giver of peace, is met and the Name comes to abide in man's mind.
8ERA: They enjoy peace, they wear peace, and they pass their lives in the peace of peace.
He enjoys peace, wears peace and in the joy of joys he passes his life.
FQU4: O Nanak, they do not forget the Naam from the mind; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
Nanak, in your mind grow not oblivious of the Name, by which honour is obtained in the court of the True Lord.
1A72: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.
By serving the True Guru happiness is produced. the True Name is the treasure of excellences.

KL2A: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.
By Guru's instruction, one recognises his ownself, and the light of Lord's Name comes into him.
DSL6: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.
The true man practises truth. The greatness is with the great Lord.
B0R1: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.
He glorifies and supplicates the Lord, to whom belong his soul, body and everything.
UZY5: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.
By singing the praises of the true lord, he abides in supreme bliss.
43ST: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.
Within his mind, though man may practises recitation, penance and self-restraint, yet without God's Name, accursed is his living.
TFXT: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.
By Guru's instruction, Lord's Name is received. The self-willed perish through worldly love.
XLCV: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||
Protect me as You willest, O Master! Nanak is your slave.
AAUZ: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.
All are yours, O lord! and you belongest to all. You are the capital of everyone.
LM1S: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.
All beg of You for alms and each day make supplication.
H24L: Those, to whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.
Whomsoever You givest, he obtains every thing. To some You are distant and to some near.
CWW1: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.
Without You, there is no place where to beg from. Let some one verify and see in his mind.
NLN8: All praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened. ||9||
All praise You, O Lord! To the Guruwards, Your door becomes manifest.
N16K: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud, but they are attached to the love of Maya.
Through love and attachment of wealth the Brahman shouts aloud when reading and reciting.
QNDH: They do not recognize God within themselves-they are so foolish and ignorant!
The foolish and ignorant man recognises not the creator who is with-in his-self.
9JS6: In the love of duality, they try to teach the world, but they do not understand meditative contemplation.
Because of love and duality, he instructs the world and himself understands not Divine knowledge.
D8RN: They lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over again. ||1||
He loses his life in vain and dies and is born again and again.
41TP: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand.
They, who wait upon the True Guru, receive Lord's Name. Reflect over and understand this.
2Z4X: Eternal peace and joy abide in their minds; they abandon their cries and complaints.
Their wailings and complaints come to an end and peace, and joy ever abide in their mind.
SZL9: Their identity consumes their identical identity, and their minds become pure by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Their self eats up its self-conceit and their mind becomes pure by reflection over Gurbani.
G746: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord. ||2||
Nanak, they, who are imbued with the Name and bear love and affection to the venerable Lord, get emancipated.
30MM: Service to the Lord is fruitful; through it, the Gurmukh is honored and approved.
Accredited is the service of God, who approves it through the Guru.
5Y5G: That person, with whom the Lord is pleased, meets with the Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord.
With whom the Lord is pleased, him meets the Guru, and he alone ponders over the Name.
GLUX: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. The Lord carries us across.
By Guru's words, God is obtained, and the Lord ferries the man across the world-ocean.
1RBA: Through stubborn-mindedness, none have found Him; go and consult the Vedas on this.
Through mind's obstinacy none has attained to God. Go and consult the vedas.
PU0V: O Nanak, he alone serves the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself. ||10||
Nanak, he alone performs God's service whom God attaches to Himself.
CZRT: O Nanak, he is a brave warrior, who conquers and subdues his vicious inner ego.
Nanak, he is the brave warrior who has subdued his vicious inner ego.
L11N: Praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukhs redeem their lives.
By praising the Name, the pious person reforms his life.
AANS: They themselves are liberated forever, and they save all their ancestors.
He himself is ever emancipated and saves all his lineage.
51SA: Those who love the Naam look beauteous at the Gate of Truth.
They who bear love to the Name, look beauteous at the True gate.
ANMM: The self-willed manmukhs die in egotism-even their death is painfully ugly.
The self-willed die in egotism. They degraded even the death (die an ignoble death).
67E1: Everything happens according to the Lord's Will; what can the poor people do?
Every thing befalls according to the Lord's will. What can poor mortals do?
W52Q: Attached to self-conceit and duality, they have forgotten their Lord and Master.
Attached to ego and duality, the man has forgotten the Master.
7WYV: O Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten. ||1||
Nanak, without the Name, all is suffering and happiness is forgotten.
LAYM: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled my doubts from within.
The perfect Guru has implanted God's Name in me, and that has dispelled doubt from within me.
M7SX: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.
Lord's Name and God's praises I did sing. The Divine light was kindled and I was shown the way.
HJLG: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me.
By effacing my ego, I fixed my attention on one God and implanted the Name within my mind.7

2CXU: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.
By Guru's instruction I got absorbed in the True Name and death's courier can not touch me.
MGLB: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He is pleased to His Name.
The creator Himself pervades everywhere. He associates to His Name those with whom He is pleased.
9628: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die in an instant. ||2||
If slave Nanak repeats God's Name, then alone, does he live. Without the Name he dies in an instant.
69FT: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.
He, who repairs to God's court, is accepted at all the courts.
37PU: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners are saved.
Wherever he goes, he stands exonerated there. By seeing his face all the sinners are saved.
FNT3: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.
Within him is the Name treasure, and through God's Name he becomes acceptable.
RYLN: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinful mistakes.
The Name he adores, the Name he believes in and God's Name effaces all his sins.
BJEK: Those who meditate on the Name, with one-pointed mind and focused consciousness, remain forever stable in the world. ||11||
They, who meditate on God's Name, with single mind and single heart, remain eternal in this world.
UWQP: Worship the Divine, Supreme Soul, with the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.
Worship you the bright Lord with the Guru-given mental equipoise.
Z4E1: If the individual soul has faith in the Supreme Soul, then it shall obtain realization within its own home.
If the individual soul has faith in the supreme soul, it shall then obtain Divine knowledge within it's home.
MUTH: The soul becomes steady, and does not waver, by the natural inclination of the Guru's Loving Will.
Like the Guru's natural inclination, the soul then becomes steady, and wavers not.
31Q3: Without the Guru, intuitive wisdom does not come, and the filth of greed does not depart from within.
Without the Guru, peace is not obtained and the filth of greed departs not from within.
EKFM: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
If God's Name dwells in the mind even for an instant and a movement, it includes bathing at all the sixty-eight place of pilgrimage.
XSVZ: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who love duality.
To the True, filth attaches not. Impurity attaches to him who harbours love for duality.
FGDP: This filth cannot be washed off, even by bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
By washing, it never departs though one may have ablutions at sixty-eight shrines.
ET4S: The self-willed manmukh does deeds in egotism; he earns only pain and more pain.
The perverse person practises deeds of pride and he earns nothing but pain over pain.
T4WX: O Nanak, the filthy ones become clean only when they meet and surrender to the True Guru. ||1||
Nanak, only then, the dirty one becomes neat and tidy, when he merges in the True Guru.
4BNQ: The self-willed manmukhs may be taught, but how can they really be taught?
The self willed -person is counseled but how can he be instructed?
LC8M: The manmukhs do not fit in at all. Because of their past actions, they are condemned to the cycle of reincarnation.
Through introduced to the good, the perverse person associated not with them, and owing to his past misdeeds goes round in transmigration.
XWFX: Loving attention to the Lord and attachment to Maya are the two separate ways; all act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
God's love and mammon's attachment are the two ways, and which act (way) one commits (treads) depends on God's Will.
JU37: The Gurmukh has conquered his own mind, by applying the Touchstone of the Shabad.
The Guruward has vanquished his mind by applying the touch stone of Gurbani.
74KQ: He fights with his mind, he settles with his mind, and he is at peace with his mind.
With his mind he contends, with his mind he parleys and with his mind he engages in contest.
48UX: All obtain the desires of their minds, through the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.
With the love of the True world, man obtains that what he desires.
L3MY: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam forever; this is how the Gurmukhs act.
He ever drinks the Name Nectar and practises deeds according to Guru's instruction.
E2TN: Those who struggle with something other than their own mind, shall depart having wasted their lives.
He who grapples with some other than his own mind, shall departs after wasting his life.
LK4S: The self-willed manmukhs, through stubborn-mindedness and the practice of falsehood, lose the game of life.
Through mind's obstinacy and the practise of falsehood and untruthfulness, the waywards lose the life game.
6KFB: Those who conquer their own mind, by Guru's Grace, lovingly focus their attention on the Lord.
He, who by Guru's grace, subdues his evil-self, fixes his love on God.
CSME: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs practice Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
Nanak, the holy man practises truth and evil one continues coming and going.
7TKF: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen, and hear the Lord's Teachings, through the True Guru.
O saintly person of God! my brothers hear you an instruction of the Godly True Guru.
ES11: Those who have good destiny pre-ordained and inscribed on their foreheads, grasp it and keep it enshrined in the heart.
The mortal, who has good fortune pre-ordained on his face and brow grasps and keeps it in his heart.
E3PC: Through the Guru's Teachings, they intuitively taste the sublime, exquisite and ambrosial sermon of the Lord.
By means of Gurbani, he has easily tasted the sublime, exquisite and ambrosial discourse of God.
M23U: The Divine Light shines in their hearts, and like the sun which removes the darkness of night, it dispels the darkness of ignorance.
There in his heart draws the Divine Light which like the sun, removing night's darkness, banished his mental ignorance.
S9R4: As Gurmukh, they behold with their eyes the Unseen, Imperceptible, Unknowable, Immaculate Lord. ||12||
Through the Guru, he beholds with his eyes the unseen, unapproachable, unknowable and immaculate Lord.8

L87Q: Those who serve their True Guru are certified and accepted.
The heads (men) who serve their True Guru, becomes fruitful.
KD72: They eradicate selfishness and conceit from within; they remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.
Having effaced their self-conceit from within them, they remain absorbed in the love of the True Lord.
UW56: Those who do not serve the True Guru waste away their lives in vain.
They, who serve not the True Guru, waste their lives in vain.
ELG4: O Nanak, the Lord does just as He pleases. No one has any say in this. ||1||
Nanak the Lord does that what he wills. None has any say there-in.
XTRC: With the mind encircled by wickedness and evil, people do evil deeds.
He, whose mind is encircled by sins, commits evil deeds.
EYRL: The ignorant worship the love of duality; in the Lord's Court they shall be punished.
The spiritually blind worship duality and they are punished in Lord's court.
N8U4: So worship the Lord, the Light of the soul; without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.
Adore you, the soul Illuming Lord but without the True Guru, his understanding cannot be obtained.
TQG7: Meditation, penance and austere self-discipline are found by surrendering to the True Guru's Will. By His Grace this is received.
Meditation penance and self mortification are in the acceptance of the True Guru's will. By God's grace man receives this understanding.
8WNX: O Nanak, serve with this intuitive awareness; only that which is pleasing to the Lord is approved. ||2||
Nanak, attentively perform the service of the Lord but that service alone shall be approved which God Likes.
601L: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; it will bring you eternal peace, day and night.
O my soul! do you meditate on Lord God's Name which will ever bring you peace by day and night.
P4AP: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; meditating on it, all sins and misdeeds shall be erased.
Repeat you the Name of the Lord Master, O my mind! by remembering which all yours evil deeds and sins will be effaced.
GJWH: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; through it, all poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.
Repeat you the Name of the Lord Master by which all the poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.
Y7EU: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; as Gurmukh, declare your love.
Lord, God's Name do you remember, O my soul! by which you shall come to embrace affection for the Supreme Exalted Guru.
RUDT: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead by the True Lord, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||
He on whose face the True One has from the very beginning, inscribed good luck, utters God's Name with his mouth.
DESQ: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad
They who serve not the True Guru and ponder not over Gurbani,
L2A5: -spiritual wisdom does not enter into their hearts; they are like dead bodies in the world.
obtain not Divine knowledge in their hearts and are as dead in the world.
7MDW: They go through the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations, and they are ruined through death and rebirth.
They go round in eighty-four lakhs of existences and are ruined in death and birth.
SBBR: He alone serves the True Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
He whom that Lord Himself causes to perform, performs the service of the True Guru.
J1B7: The Treasure of the Naam is within the True Guru; by His Grace, it is obtained.
In the True Guru is the Name treasure, which is obtained by God's grace.
FU9Q: Those who are truly attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad-their love is forever True.
Ever sincere is the affection of those who are truly imbued with the Guru's words.
4S7K: O Nanak, those who are united with Him shall not be separated again. They merge imperceptibly into God. ||1||
Nanak, he whom God unites with Himself, separated not from Him and is easily absorbed in Him.
J8JS: One who knows the Benevolent Lord God is the true devotee of Bhagaautee.
He is the man of God's sect who knows the Auspicious Master,
CUPJ: By Guru's Grace, he is self-realized.
and by Guru's grace recognises his ownself.
3HLH: He restrains his wandering mind, and brings it back to its own home within the self.
He restrains his wandering mind and brings the One God in his heart-home.
1FMA: He remains dead while yet alive, and he chants the Name of the Lord.
He remains dead while alive and repeats the Name of God.
PCFC: Such a Bhagaautee is most exalted.
HPPJ: O Nanak, he merges into the True One. ||2||
He is absorbed in the True Lord O Nanak!
VB1F: He is full of deceit, and yet he calls himself a devotee of Bhagaautee.
There is deception within his mind and he calls himself a true devotee.
R6WJ: Through hypocrisy, he shall never attain the Supreme Lord God.
Through hypocrisy he shall never obtain the Supreme Lord.
VF07: He slanders others, and pollutes himself with his own filth.
He slanders others and soils his soul with filth.
F76U: Outwardly, he washes off the filth, but the impurity of his mind does not go away.
He washes off the filth from outside, but his heart's impurity goes not.
DLS4: He argues with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
With the saints congregation he picks up a quarrel.
DDEH: Night and day, he suffers, engrossed in the love of duality.
Absorbed in the love of duality night and day, he remains miserable.
V6H3: He does not remember the Name of the Lord, but still, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.
He remembers not God's Name and performs many rituals.
CK82: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.
What is destined from the very outset, that cannot be effaced.
J5F8: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||3||
Nanak, without serving the True Guru, salvation is not obtained.
A43Y: Those who meditate on the True Guru shall not be burnt to ashes.
They, who dwell on the True Guru, burn not to ashes.
6WYB: Those who meditate on the True Guru are satisfied and fulfilled.
They, who dwell on the True Guru, are satisfied and satiated.
QYDR: Those who meditate on the True Guru are not afraid of the Messenger of Death.
They, who think of the True Guru, have no fear of death.9

QDCG: Those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, fall at the Feet of the True Guru.
They, to whom God becomes merciful, fall at the True Guru's feet.
Y655: Here and hereafter, their faces are radiant; they go to the Lord's Court in robes of honor. ||14||
Here and hereafter their faces are bright. They go to God's court arrayed with the robe of honour.
E2CK: Chop off that head which does not bow to the Lord.
Cut off the head ; the head which bows not to the Lord.
F8GF: O Nanak, that human body, in which there is no pain of separation from the Lord-take that body and burn it. ||1||
Nanak, take and burn the human frame, an which there is not he pang of separation from God.
6X13: Forgetting the Primal Lord, O Nanak, people are born and die, over and over again.
Having forgotten the Primal being, O Nanak! (the creative woman) is born and dies, again and again.
TBUL: Mistaking it for musk, they have fallen into the stinking pit of filth. ||2||
Mistaking it for musk, she has fallen into the filthy pit.
29HD: Meditate on that Name of the Lord, O my mind, whose Command rules over all.
My soul! remember you that, such, Name of God, who rules over all.
MX9Z: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which will save you at the very last moment.
My Soul! repeat you that such Name of God which shall rescue you at the last moment.
X5NP: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which shall drive out all hunger and desire from your mind.
My soul! repeat you that, such. Name of God, which shall drive out all your mind's desires and hungers.
GK6W: Very fortunate and blessed is that Gurmukh who chants the Naam; it shall bring all slanderers and wicked enemies to fall at his feet.
Through the Guru the very fortunate fellow ponders on the Name, which makes all the slanderers and sinners fall at His feet.
01T2: O Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Greatest Name of all, before which all come and bow. ||15||
Nanak, do you deliberates over the most Exalted Name of God, before which Name all come and kneel down.
5Q11: She may wear good clothes, but the bride is ugly and rude; her mind is false and impure.
The unsightly and of evil-disposition bride wears good clothes but her soul is impure and false.
LWD9: She does not walk in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord. Instead, she foolishly gives Him orders.
She walks not according to the will of her spouse. The ignorant bide, rather, gives Him orders.
6QWM: But she who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall be spared all pain and suffering.
She who walks in the will of the Guru, escapes all the miseries.
FU8E: That destiny which was pre-ordained by the Creator cannot be erased.
The one which the Creator had pre-ordained, that writ cannot be erased.
K5YK: She must dedicate her mind and body to her Husband Lord, and enshrine love for the Word of the Shabad.
She ought to dedicate her soul and body to her spouse, and nurture affection for His world.
7USD: Without His Name, no one has found Him; see this and reflect upon it in your heart.
See and reflect on this in your mind, without the Name's meditation, none has obtained the Lord.
PHRF: O Nanak, she is beautiful and graceful; the Creator Lord ravishes and enjoys her. ||1||
Nanak, beauteous and well-conducted is she, whom the creator enjoys.
9D4M: Attachment to Maya is an ocean of darkness; neither this shore nor the one beyond can be seen.
The love of wealth is darkness. It's this shore and yonder one are not seen.
A6UH: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs suffer in terrible pain; they forget the Lord's Name and drown.
The ignorant self -willed person suffer supreme pain and are drowned, forgetting God's Name.
GPP9: They arise in the morning and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are caught in the love of duality.
Arising in the morning they perform many rituals and their attachment is with duality.
R9QC: Those who serve the True Guru cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
They who serve their True Guru, cross the terrible -ocean.
1W8K: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts; they are absorbed into the True One. ||2||
Nanak, the Guruwards keep the True Name clasped to their heart and get absorbed in the True Lord.
441C: The Lord pervades and permeates the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.
God is fully pervading the ocean, the sandy tracts, the earth and the sky, Besides Him there is no other second.
LXK3: The Lord Himself sits upon His Throne and administers justice. He beats and drives out the false-hearted.
Seated (on the throne), God Himself administers justice and thrashing all the false, He drives them off.
PTC2: The Lord bestows glorious greatness upon those who are truthful. He administers righteous justice.
To the truthful God grants greatness and administers even handed justice.
QF5Q: So praise the Lord, everybody; He protects the poor and the lost souls.
You all praise the Lord, who protects the poor and the masterless.
B7BF: He honors the righteous and punishes the sinners. ||16||
He grants laurels to the virtuous and to the evil-doer He awards punishment.
E4PK: The self-willed manmukh, the foolish bride, is a filthy, rude and evil wife.
The waywards woman is filthy, ill-natured and an evil wife.
BMCU: Forsaking her Husband Lord and leaving her own home, she gives her love to another.
She leaves her Husband and home and bears affection to another person.
DYC3: Her desires are never satisfied, and she burns and cries out in pain.
Her passion is never extinguished she burns and cries aloud.
3MPP: O Nanak, without the Name, she is ugly and ungraceful. She is abandoned and left behind by her Husband Lord. ||1||
Nanak, without God's Name, she is unsightly and unhandsome, and her Husband has forsaken and abandoned her.0

D1VK: The happy soul-bride is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; she is in love with the True Guru.
She, who is imbued with Gurbani and bears love and affection to the True Guru, is a happy bride.
2N4S: She continually enjoys and ravishes her Beloved, with true love and affection.
With true attachment and reverential regards, she ever enjoys her Beloved.
7795: She is such a loveable, beautiful and noble woman.
She is extremely lovable, beauteous and praise -worthy wife.
FH8X: O Nanak, through the Naam, the happy soul-bride unites with the Lord of Union. ||2||
Nanak, with the Name of her Lord, she is made the true bride and the Blender blends her with Himself.
35DH: Lord, everyone sings Your Praises. You have freed us from bondage.
All sings yours praises, O God! who has set free the entrapped.
PPBK: Lord, everyone bows in reverence to You. You have saved us from our sinful ways.
Everyone makes obeisance to You, O Lord! who has rescued one from sins.
ALUA: Lord, You are the Honor of the dishonored. Lord, You are the Strongest of the strong.
O God! You are the honour of the dishonoued. You are the strongest of the strong, my Lord.
LTLF: The Lord beats down the egocentrics and corrects the foolish, self-willed manmukhs.
God beats down the egoists and corrects the self- willed fools.
S9TV: The Lord bestows glorious greatness on His devotees, the poor, and the lost souls. ||17||
God grants glory to His saints, the poor and the patronless.
LJQ9: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, obtains the greatest glory.
He, who walks according to the will of the True Guru, obtains great honour.
S5VR: The Exalted Name of the Lord abides in his mind, and no one can take it away.
The exalted Name of God abides in his heart, and none can undo his renown.
F4SR: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Grace, receives His Mercy.
He, to whom the Lord shows His kindness, obtains His Name through meritorious deeds.
KBUA: O Nanak, creativity is under the control of the Creator; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this! ||1||
Nanak, the creation is in the power of the creator. Rare is the one who realises it through the True Guru.
WNLF: O Nanak, those who worship and adore the Lord's Name night and day, vibrate the String of the Lord's Love.
Nanak, they, who meditate on God's Name, night and day, abide in the Lord's constant love.
FYJ2: Maya, the maid-servant of our Lord and Master, serves them.
The mammon, the maid -servant of the Master performs services before them.
F2FP: The Perfect One has made them perfect; by the Hukam of His Command, they are embellished.
The perfect one, the reformer, by His order has made them perfect.
9LNA: By Guru's Grace, they understand Him, and they find the gate of salvation.
They, who by Guru's favour understand God, obtain the gate of salvation.
YWPL: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Lord's Command; they are beaten down by the Messenger of Death.
The waqywards understand not Lord's fiat. Them, the death's courier beats with a rod.
N788: But the Gurmukhs, who worship and adore the Lord, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
They, who dwell on the Lord, by Guru's grace, cross the terrible world-ocean.
EMJ3: All their demerits are erased, and replaced with merits. The Guru Himself is their Forgiver. ||2||
The Guru, who himself is the pardoner, wipes out all their demerits with merits.
R9FP: The Lord's devotees have faith in Him. The Lord knows everything.
His serfs have confidence in God. The Lord knows every thing.
N5AL: No one is as great a Knower as the Lord; the Lord administers righteous justice.
None is as great a knower as God. The Lord administers nothing but justice.
B6KC: Why should we feel any burning anxiety, since the Lord does not punish without just cause?
Why should we feel burning and anxiety when the Lord punishes not without justification?
RLNE: True is the Master, and True is His Justice; only the sinners are defeated.
True is the master and true his justice. The vicious man alone suffers defeat.
9V8E: O devotees, praise the Lord with your palms pressed together; the Lord saves His humble devotees. ||18||
Praise you, O saint! the Lord with hands folded. God saves the saintly persons.
K6SM: Oh, if only I could meet my Beloved, and keep Him enshrined deep within my heart!
May I meet my beloved and continue to hold him to my mind and heart.
BWTQ: I praise that God forever and ever, through love and affection for the Guru.
Through the love and affection of the Guru, I praise that, Lord for never and aye.
ZQAA: O Nanak, that one upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace is united with Him; such a person is the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||1||
Nanak, own whom is His grace, He unites her with Himself. She alone, is the faithful bride of the Lord.
AJJ8: Serving the Guru, the Lord is obtained, when He bestows His Glance of Grace.
He, to whom God shows mercy, obtains Him by performing the service of the Guru.
MER4: They are transformed from humans into angels, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By meditating on God's Name. From the mortals they become demigods.
RDME: They conquer their egotism and merge with the Lord; they are saved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
They efface their ego, unite with the Lord, and are saved by Guru's word.
B86E: O Nanak, they merge imperceptibly into the Lord, who has bestowed His Favor upon them. ||2||
Nanak, they on whom God confers His favour, are easily absorbed in Him.
H6V4: The Lord Himself inspires us to worship Him; He reveals His Glorious Greatness.
By putting man to his devotional service, God has manifested His glory.1
7Z57: He Himself inspires us to place our faith in Him. Thus He performs His Own Service.
God causes the devotee to place faith in Him and through him performs His own service.
